parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: Specifies the storage location e.g. SM SIM card, ME device memory.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.description: The maximum number of SMS messages in {{object|Device.Cellular.Interface.{i}.SMS.Message}} that can be stored in Storage.

parameters.name: StorageAvailable
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SMS Storage is available to receive new messages. {{true}} means that there is storage still available; {{false}} means that the storage is full.

parameters.name: AvailableCapacity
parameters.description: The number of SMS messages in {{object|Device.Cellular.Interface.{i}.SMS.Message}} that the Storage entity has room to store, which can not exceed {{param|Capacity}}.

object.description: Represents a SMS storage location. Each instance of this object corresponds to a distinct SMS storage area. Multiple instances of this object may exist, each representing a different storage type (e.g., SM SIM card, ME device memory).
